newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-DIARY-Australia statistics schedule end March.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-DIARY-Australia statistics schedule end March.

text.p: The Australian Bureau of Statistics has scheduled the following figures for release to mid-March.
Data are issued at 11.30 a.m. (0030 GMT).
For forecasts, see the weekly Consensus report for Australian indicators (Key AU/ECI f9).
Jan 09 - Job Vacancies and Overtime, November quarter
- Building materials (ex housing) price index, Nov
Jan 29 - Consumer Price Index, December quarter
Jan 30 - New Motor Vehicle Registrations, December
Feb 04 - Retail trade, December and December quarter
Feb 06 - Average weekly ordinary time earnings, three months
Feb 10 - Housing materials price index, December
- Building materials (ex housing) price index, Dec
Feb 27 - Private new Capital Expenditure, December quarter
- Average weekly ordinary time earnings, three months
Feb 28 - New Motor Vehicle Registrations, January
Mar 03 - Stocks and Selected Inventory Sales, Dec quarter
Mar 06 - International Investment Position, December quarter
Mar 07 - Housing materials price index, January
- Building materials (ex housing) price index, Jan
Mar 11 - Indexes of Industrial Production, December quarter
Mar 18 - Dwelling Unit Commencements, December quarter
Mar 28 - New Motor Vehicle Registrations, February
